data.one_liner: A Dart List where filters can be applied and elements accessed or modified in that state.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FilteredList class that allows applying filters while retaining the ability to access, modify, insert, or remove elements relative to the filtered or original state.
use_when: You need a collection list that supports active filtering while allowing modifications.
You want to manipulate items within a filtered subset or the original underlying list seamlessly.
avoid_when: You need reactive state management frameworks to handle list UI rebuilds automatically.
You require range modification operations like removeRange, fillRange, or replaceRange which are not yet implemented.
strengths: Allows fine-grained operations relative to filtered or original scopes (e.g. remove vs removeFromOriginal).
Simple API that mirrors a standard Dart List.
weaknesses: Several range methods (removeRange, fillRange, replaceRange) are not implemented yet.
Limited documentation and features outside of basic list manipulations.
